records.part: Licenses, enhancements, upgrades, software maintenance and technical support for the existing Q-Flow Automated Queuing System
records.reason: ACF Technologies Inc, is the sole provider and distributor of licenses, enhancements, upgrades, software maintenance and support of the Department’s current Q-Flow Automated Queuing System and have exclusive rights to all licenses, enhancements, upgrades, software maintenance and support needed to maintain continuity of this integrated queuing system.
